etymologies.etymologyHTML: From fish +‎ -ery.

definitions.definition: (uncountable) Fishing: the catching, processing and marketing of fish or other seafood.
A place where fish or other seafood are caught: a fishing ground.

quote.citation: 1904, “Report of the Conservation commission of Maryland for 1908-1909”, in (Please provide the book title or journal name), number 3:
quote.text: While the present conservation of Maryland fisheries is largely concerned with the oyster, which promises such great future returns, the foodfishes should not be neglected.

quote.citation: 1995 December 26, William J. Broad, “Creatures of the Deep Find Their Way to the Table”, in The New York Times‎[1]:
quote.text: This fishery, which at its peak produced more than 80,000 tons a year, is now in decline.

definitions.definition: A place where fish or other seafood are raised: a fish farm.
A place where fish or other seafood are processed: a seafood factory.
(countable) A place related to fishing, particularly:
(countable) A right to fish in a particular location; Territorial fishing waters.
